title: Experimental Evaluation of Algorithm-Assisted Human Decision-Making: Application to Pretrial Public Safety Assessment
reasoning: The paper's central theme is the evaluation of an algorithmic tool's impact on human decisions within the ethically charged context of the criminal justice system. It develops and applies a methodology to explicitly assess the fairness of these decisions (Section 3.6 'Fairness') and their optimality based on a utility function that weighs the societal costs of different outcomes, such as unnecessarily harsh decisions (Section 3.7 'Optimal Decision Rule'). This represents a core evaluation of the ethical implications and fairness of algorithmic assistance, not merely a peripheral discussion.
